title: Walk through Kurt Vonnegut’s ‘Slaughterhouse-Five’ in new exhibition
summary: Julia Withead, founder and CEO of the Kurt Vonnegut Museum & Library, worked with students from Purdue University’s engineering program for the “Tralfamadore: An Immersive Slaughterhouse-Five Experience” exhibition.

title: An overnight parking program for people living in their cars is back. The need has not gone away
summary: Not all people experiencing homelessness sleep outdoors or in shelters, many live in their cars. The goal of Safe Park Indy is to connect some of those people with a safe place to park at night.

title: Problem-solving courts are a lifeline. Now they're being cut
summary: Marion County is winding down courts that support people with mental health and substance-use.

title: New signs along Indianapolis Cultural Trail aim to help people find nearby attractions
summary: The Indianapolis Cultural Trail launched a new program to help people navigate from the trail to nearby points of interest.
